text:
Jay Hunter (I am the anonymous poster therefore using a nickname to be consistent) 
according to PIBA’s email, paying the deposit voids the appeal. From what you say it sounds like: we file an appeal within 21 days, then pay up within 45 days regardless of whether a decision was delivered on the appeal. If so, what is the point of allowing appeals?

Also the visa offices were fully closed from the next working day after our interview, and no staff was working so nobody could possibly review our appeal. Therefore, I wish to understand if PIBA can proceed with closing our file solely on the grounds that 45 calendar days passed, regardless of external circumstances like war or that we had filed an appeal?
